question: Where should I start if I want to learn about building efficient AI agents?

scene.title: Start here: Building Efficient AI Agents

narration.text: Start with the four-part Building Efficient AI Agents series. It takes about 43 minutes to read in full.
Part 1 is the place to begin. It's a four-minute read on the mental model and core architecture.
Part 2 covers choosing a stack, deployment patterns and real cost figures.
Once the ideas make sense, part 3 has working ReAct agents in Python and Node.js.
Finish with part 4, the longest at 19 minutes. It covers security, evaluation and running agents in production.

data.caption: Read in order: about 43 minutes for all 4 parts

items.subtitle: 4 min · How agents behave predictably, plus an architecture that holds up in production
